bio: Take a trip into the city of Dublin and experience the eloquence of Afternoon Tea whilst doing so in the welcoming and friendly atmosphere of Conrad Hotel. The hotel's tranquil terrace setting is the perfect place to enjoy the many fresh delicious option on the Conrad menu. The sweet and savoury options that align the carefully crafted menu allow for the customer to mix and match between a delightful assortment of dishes.  The Afternoon Tea is served on elegant white tables and chairs and aid the fine dining experience. This fine dining experience encompasses the elegance and five-star quality available at the Conrad hotel.  The hotel is surrounded by many of Dublin’s main sites of interest such as the National Museum of Ireland and the St Patricks Cathedral.  The Stephen's Green East train station is a short 2 minute walk away from the Hotel making travel extremely easy to and from the hotel.
